items.t: X-ELIO and e-STORAGE Partner to Deploy 590 MW / 1.43 GWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems Across the U.S. and Australia
items.sum: Canadian Solar Inc. (the "Company" or "Canadian Solar") (NASDAQ: CSIQ) announced today at RE+ 2026, one of North America's largest clean energy events, that e-STORAGE, its energy storage solutions business, has signed agreements with X-ELIO, a global renewable energy developer, to supply five battery energy storage projects totaling 590 MW / 1.43 GWh DC.
